cards.card_text: Then Joseph tells the people, "Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land." SEED in a famine, friend, that's like finding fresh dough right after you scraped the last crumbs off the tray!
cards.verse_text: Then Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.
cards.snippet: …your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.

cards.card_text: For six years they sow, prune and gather, but year seven is a Sabbath of complete rest for the land.
cards.verse_text: For six years you may sow your field and prune your vineyard and gather its crops.
cards.snippet: For six years you may sow your field and prune your vineyard and gather its crops.

cards.card_text: True or false: In the Jubilee year, God tells Israel not to sow the land or harvest the untended vines.
cards.verse_text: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.
cards.snippet: …fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.

cards.card_text: Then He says out loud what they might be wondering: "What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?"
cards.verse_text: Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’
cards.snippet: …‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’

cards.card_text: Even the seed they sow will be sown in vain.
cards.verse_text: You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
cards.snippet: You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

cards.card_text: The Israelites will sow their seed in vain, because their ___ will eat it.
cards.verse_text: You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
cards.snippet: You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

cards.card_text: Moses says they will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the ___ will consume it.
cards.verse_text: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
cards.snippet: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will…

cards.card_text: They'll sow and reap again Assyria will come back for them They'll have to leave the land
cards.verse_text: But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
cards.snippet: But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

cards.card_text: Eliphaz says he's seen it for himself: those who plow iniquity and sow trouble ___ the same.
cards.verse_text: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
cards.snippet: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.

cards.card_text: They sow fields and plant vineyards, and the harvest comes in fruitful.
cards.verse_text: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
cards.snippet: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.

cards.card_text: Then the song walks out into a farm field: "Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy." Friend, I've cried into a batch of dough before, and the dough did NOT care.
cards.verse_text: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
cards.snippet: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.

cards.card_text: sow travel speak
cards.verse_text: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
cards.snippet: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.

cards.card_text: The one who keeps watching the wind fails to sow.
cards.verse_text: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
cards.snippet: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.

cards.card_text: Then the Teacher says to sow your seed in the morning, and not to rest your hands in the evening.
cards.verse_text: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in the evening, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or if both will equally prosper.
cards.snippet: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in…

cards.card_text: The Teacher says to sow in the morning and keep working in the evening.
cards.verse_text: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in the evening, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or if both will equally prosper.
cards.snippet: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in…

cards.card_text: Those who sow beside abundant waters Those who build houses on the rock Those who store grain in barns
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.
cards.snippet: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.

cards.card_text: They will sow and reap again They will leave the land for good They will live off the king's storehouses
cards.verse_text: But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
cards.snippet: But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

cards.card_text: They water the earth so it buds and sprouts and gives seed to sow and food to eat.
cards.verse_text: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat, so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
cards.snippet: …watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat, so My word that proceeds from My mouth…

cards.card_text: Then the LORD tells the men of Judah and Jerusalem, "Break up your unplowed ground, and do not sow among the thorns." It's like dough that sat out all night: NOTHING gets stamped into it until you work it first.
cards.verse_text: For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: “Break up your unplowed ground, and do not sow among the thorns.
cards.snippet: …of Judah and Jerusalem: “Break up your unplowed ground, and do not sow among the thorns.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah, the way a farmer sows a field.
cards.verse_text: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and of beast.
cards.snippet: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed…

cards.card_text: And Jonadab didn't stop at wine: "Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard." Forget house rules, baker, these folks don't even GET a house!
cards.verse_text: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard.
cards.snippet: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says He'll sow her as His own in the land.
cards.verse_text: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
cards.snippet: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion…

cards.card_text: Then comes the big line: "For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind." And the fields?
cards.verse_text: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind.
cards.snippet: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind.

cards.card_text: Then comes this: “Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground.” That's dough straight out of the fridge, friend: you can't roll out ANYTHING until you break it up first.
cards.verse_text: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground.
cards.snippet: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up…

cards.card_text: The LORD says the people of the city will sow seed.
cards.verse_text: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.
cards.snippet: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with…

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says to look at the birds of the air: they do not sow or reap or gather into barns.
cards.verse_text: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them.
cards.snippet: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds…

cards.card_text: The birds don't sow, reap or gather into barns.
cards.verse_text: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them.
cards.snippet: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds…

cards.card_text: Then He tells them many things in parables, starting with a farmer who goes out to sow his seed.
cards.verse_text: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
cards.snippet: …told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.

cards.card_text: They ask, “Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field?
cards.verse_text: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field?
cards.snippet: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field?

cards.card_text: Jesus opens with one word: "Listen!" A farmer goes out to sow his seed, and just like my sprinkles, it doesn't all land in one place.
cards.verse_text: A farmer went out to sow his seed.
cards.snippet: A farmer went out to sow his seed.

cards.card_text: It starts simple: a farmer goes out to sow his seed.
cards.verse_text: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, He told them this parable: “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
cards.snippet: …after town, He told them this parable: “A farmer went out to sow his seed.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says to consider the ravens: they don't sow or reap, and they have no storehouse or barn.
cards.verse_text: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them.
cards.snippet: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them.

cards.card_text: The servant tells the master to his FACE that he's a harsh man who withdraws what he did not deposit and reaps what he did not sow.
cards.verse_text: You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’ His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words.
cards.snippet: …withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’ His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your…

cards.card_text: Paul skips the warm-up and starts his answer with two words: "You fool!" Then he heads straight out to the field: "What you sow does not come to life unless it dies."
cards.verse_text: What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
cards.snippet: What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

cards.card_text: Paul says the seed you sow is just a seed, not the body it will become.
cards.verse_text: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
cards.snippet: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps…

cards.card_text: What does he say peacemakers who sow in peace reap?
cards.verse_text: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
cards.snippet: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.

cards.card_text: Peter wraps up by saying two proverbs are true of them: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
cards.verse_text: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
cards.snippet: …the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”

cards.card_text: Peter's two proverbs show a dog returning to its vomit and a washed sow going back to the mud.
cards.verse_text: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
cards.snippet: …the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
